meta.about: Crabs that sit disguised as scenery and wake when a player steps next to them. Pairs and animations are from the cache (every crab shares one skeleton: 1314 sinks it, 1316 is 1314 reversed; 1316 lasts 74 client cycles, so a crab rises for 3 ticks before it can move or attack); behaviour from the OSRS Wiki (Sand Crab, Rock Crab, Tolerance). restTicks isn't documented anywhere and is an estimate.
